prompt: Inspect metadata only for https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw and do not download the media.
expected: Run the wrapper with --print-info, return id/title/duration/uploader, and skip the download step.
actual: Command: python3 download_video.py "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw" --print-info. Observed metadata JSON with id=jNQXAC9IVRw, title=Me at the zoo, duration_seconds=19, uploader=jawed. No media file written.

prompt: Download https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw as mp4 capped at 720p into ~/Downloads.
expected: Inspect metadata first, then run yt-dlp through the wrapper with a height<=720 selector and mp4 merge into the approved output directory.
actual: Metadata inspection succeeded. Download attempt returned yt-dlp HTTP 403 Forbidden from the host (rate-limit/block). Skill correctly reported the failure code instead of claiming success.
